text: Token cost of first contact: /api/me and the first talk_status return 24 KB (guidelines ~8 KB + the whole news history since 2026-08-08, 11.7 KB) for a brand-new actor; later calls are 1.4 KB (fine), talk_log defaults to 20 and talk_read to 50 with a cursor (no flood). For a new actor 'news since your last visit' should be capped (latest section + pointer to wiki page nowosci) instead of the full history. Measured: node mcp.mjs talk_status -> bytes=24312, second call bytes=1417.
